result.description: Cloud observability and security platform for monitoring infrastructure, apps, logs, and traces.
result.auth_detail: REST API: org API key plus user-owned application key (headers DD-API-KEY / DD-APPLICATION-KEY) for reads. OAuth2 exists in Datadog but client registration goes through the Partner Sandbox/Developer Platform. MCP server prefers OAuth 2.0 and also accepts tokens or key headers (per setup page summary, not verified verbatim).
result.access_detail: Keys can be created by any user in Organization settings, but need a Datadog org. Pricing page offers a free trial and then a Free tier limited to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention. Trial or free-tier org is enough for working API keys. OAuth clients for public apps need a Partner Sandbox account.
result.api_notes: Public REST API v1/v2 covering metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards, incidents, SLOs, security, synthetics and more. Regional site-specific base URLs (api.datadoghq.com, .eu, us3, us5, ap1, and others).

evidence.quote: Requests that read data require full access and also require an `application key`.
Requests that write data require reporting access and require an `API key`.
Learn about how Datadog uses OAuth 2.0.
Navigate to Organization settings, then click the API keys or Client Tokens tab.
On the Free tier, you get up to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention, at no cost.
Application keys, in conjunction with your organization's API key, give users access to Datadog's programmatic API.
The Datadog MCP Server acts as a bridge between your observability data in Datadog and any AI agents
The MCP Server has a fair-use burst limit of 50 tool calls per 10 seconds.
